thread:
alex_cs: FYI — BigBank EBR next Wed. Onboarding still at ~60% (hang on SSO + docs). Risk: renewal could be soft if we don't show adoption lift. Need slides + exec alignment.

sarah_success: Thanks, noted. Can you post the current onboarding tracker link? want to pull adoption charts. :eyes: 

alex_cs: tracker: https://redwoodhq.internal/bigbank/onboarding-tracker (latest tab 'QBR prep')

mike_ae: I'll pull usage & latency stats for the last 30d. Any particular KPIs exec wants?

nora_exec: focus on MAU, cost per inference trend, and top 3 blockers for platform adoption. Keep slides short (4-6).

olivia_csm: I'll consolidate customer asks from support & PM feedback into one slide. Suggest we include a timeline for SSO fix + docs patch.

alex_cs: Action items: 1) usage charts (mike_ae) 2) onboarding blockers + ETA (ting_engineer) 3) customer ask summary (olivia_csm) 4) renewal risk mitigation bullets for exec (sarah_success). Can everyone ack ownership + rough ETA?

mike_ae: ack — will post charts by EOD today (1761003723).

ting_engineer: ack — SSO root cause identified (missing redirect in proxy). PR in review, target patch deploy Tue AM. I'll put short note for slide: "SSO fix in QA, deploying Tue".

olivia_csm: ack — compiling asks now, will add a 1-slide roadmap mapping asks -> delivery windows by tomorrow AM.

sarah_success: ack — I'll draft the executive mitigation bullets and escalation ask (seat-based pilot + 90d adoption plan) by tomorrow noon.

alex_cs: Great. Also: enablement plan — want a tailored enablement session for BigBank success team the week after EBR. Olivia, can you coordinate dates?

olivia_csm: yep, will propose slots in calendar and prep a 45-min walkthrough + hands-on lab.

enablement-bot: New event created: "BigBank EBR dry-run" Tue 10:00-10:45 (room: Zoom). Organizer: alex_cs.

alex_cs: Can we do a dry-run Tue 10 with execs Nora + Sarah on the call? Nora, will you be available?

nora_exec: I can do Tue 10 for the dry-run. I'll give 5 mins opening remarks and backstop questions.

alex_cs: Perfect. Quick ask — Mike, can you include a short cost vs. value slide showing projected per-seat ROI if adoption hits 75%? simple table is fine.

mike_ae: will do.

alex_cs: Last: capture CSAT/NPS snippets in the slides (2 quotes max) and a single asks slide with 1-2 exec asks (e.g., shorten FTO timeline). Keep everything to max 6 slides.

olivia_csm: I'll pull quotes from support threads and redact PII.

alex_cs: Timeline recap: EOD today: usage charts (mike). Tomorrow AM: asks + roadmap (olivia). Tomorrow noon: exec bullets (sarah). Tue 10: dry-run. Wed: EBR. If anything slips ping me.

sarah_success: noted. I'll also prep a 1-paragraph renewal playbook we can share post-EBR (follow-up plan + OKRs).

ting_engineer: PR merged, deploying Tue 02:15 UTC. Will post deploy bot msg once live.

alex_cs: Thanks team — huge impact if we tighten this. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deployed commit 9f3c4a to staging at 1761004323 — smoke passes.

alex_cs: Logged — will update slides after deploy confirmation.

olivia_csm: quick note: customer asked for an enablement recording. I'll capture the session and link in follow-up doc.

mike_ae: uploaded charts to slides deck: https://redwoodhq.slides/bigbank-ebr (v3).

alex_cs: Awesome. See you at the dry-run.
